text.p: British election campaign events scheduled for Friday include:

- Prime Minister John Major holds news conference at 0915 BST/0815 GMT, Conservative Central Office, with Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind and Trade Secretary Ian Lang before leaving for campaign tour.
- Labour leader Tony Blair and economics spokesman Gordon Brown launch their party's business manifesto in the City at 1045 BST/0945 GMT. Blair then pays a campaign visit in London.
- Liberal Democrats news conference at 0800 BST/0700 GMT
- The Green Party and the Natural Law Party launch their manifestoes, separately, at 1000 BST/0900 GMT.
